properties.statement: Wrote a throwaway Python script that speaks JSON-RPC over stdio to a client of the shared server, purely to make four ordinary tool calls that this session's own MCP connection could not make: setting a list-valued parameter added to two constructors earlier in the same session. The harness caches the tool schema from its handshake, so a parameter that did not exist when the session started is serialised as a string and the deserialiser refuses it. The tool was right, the design was right, and the only route to it was a second client.
